name: 06484 · Shelton, CT
findings: ZIP 06484 (Shelton) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06484 (Shelton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06484 (Shelton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
